audit.why: Lucian owns levels 1-2 on Piercing Light plus a Lightslinger double-shot before any poison exists; Cassiopeia takes over from 3 once Noxious Blast into Twin Fang chains. Consistent with 59.91% over 227 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike and the cooldown block never gave a number for Relentless Pursuit, so 'commit while it is down' was unusable.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s and is shortened by every Lightslinger attack — that is the actual spike window.
audit.corrected: Both now carry 16s at rank 1 plus the Lightslinger reduction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wrote 'Twin Fangs' (real name Twin Fang). Petrifying Gaze was sold as an anti-engage button without stating that it only stuns enemies FACING Cassiopeia. Lightslinger's auto-reset tell was never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot text: Petrifying Gaze stuns enemies in front of her that are facing her and only slows those with their back turned. Lightslinger makes his next attack a double-shot after any ability cast (autoReset flag).
audit.corrected: Name fixed to Twin Fang; the facing requirement of Petrifying Gaze and the Lightslinger double-shot wind-up are now stated; Miasma grounding Relentless Pursuit is tied to a drop point.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'lock him down while it is on cooldown' with no duration anywhere.
audit.why: A real number is what makes the count actionable, and the Lightslinger reduction means the clock is not the right thing to count.
audit.corrected: 16s rank 1, cut by every Lightslinger hit — count his autos.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze punishes any face-first E engage — if he dashes in looking at you, R stuns him and chained Twin Fangs off your poison delete a squishy ADC.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze punishes any face-first E engage — Relentless Pursuit is a 16s dash at rank 1, so R him mid-dash and chained Twin Fang deletes a squishy ADC.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash — lock him down while it is on cooldown. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Miasma has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, but every Lightslinger hit shaves it, so count his autos, not the clock. - Your W Miasma has one job: grounding that dash. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: His dash — lock him down while it is on cooldown. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Noxious Blast reaches 850, his Piercing Light only 500 — poison from outside it.

edits.before: Lucian spends Relentless Pursuit early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Twin Fang is a 0.75s cooldown on a poisoned target — every extra second is damage.

edits.before: That’s Lucian’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: His combo opens with a Lightslinger double-shot — the auto wind-up is the tell.

edits.before: Spamming E without poison until your mana bar dies — and then standing in Relentless Pursuit range with Miasma on cooldown.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing you — turn into his dash instead of running, or your 120s ult just slows his back.

edits.before: Track Lucian’s Relentless Pursuit: His dash — lock him down while it is on cooldown. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Relentless Pursuit: 16s at rank 1, cut by every Lightslinger hit. Miasma grounds it — drop it under him, not behind.

edits.before: Q poke on his last-hits starts the poison economy — you're annoying now and lethal in ten minutes.
edits.after: He owns level 1: Piercing Light plus a Lightslinger double-shot chunks you before poison exists.

edits.before: W Miasma online — the grounding zone deletes dash kits from the matchup while it sits there.
edits.after: Miasma lands at 2 but costs 24s at rank 1 — miss it and his Q-plus-double-shot still wins.
